provenance.notes: The package calls no Colissimo service yet: it rates from the "rates" option only, hence no limit to count. Colissimo's web services, when wired: the SLS label service needs the contract number and its password (the customer answers for every connection made with them), at most 5 parcels in a multi-parcel shipment; the tracking service (Suivi TL v2.1) also needs the calling IP addresses registered with Colissimo. No published quota.
